test_title: PYST 38: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
E, F, G, H, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table (but not necessarily in the same order). Only one person sits between E and L when counted from the left of L. K sits third to the right of J. F sits third to the left of G. K sits to the immediate right of F. H is not an immediate neighbour of F.

How many people sit between H and L when counted from the right of H?
solution: Given: E, F, G, H, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table (but not necessarily in the same order). 1) Only one person sits between E and L when counted from the left of L. 2) K sits third to the right of J. 3) F sits third to the left of G.
